title: Custom GPUI terminal element
requirements: Pin gpui and gpui_platform exactly to zed commit 03e5ad8a630c84c3990055905d0444ea0a519b7f; no floating revision and no second renderer.

Expose the planned pooled RowDelta and FrameDelta boundary with sequence, GridSize, DamageKind, changed rows with generations/cells/runs, cursor state, selection state, styles, and an image-delta placeholder owned by the terminal engine side.
TerminalElement paint consumes an owned or shared FrameDelta and never locks Terminal or the engine.

Implement GPUI Element layout, exact font resolution and shaping through GPUI/CoreText, run batching, backgrounds, glyphs and emoji, underline and strikethrough, cursor block/bar/underline/hollow shapes and blink scheduling, selection, focus, IME registration, damage application, atlas/font invalidation, and resize deduplication.
Render cache reuses retained vectors/batches and performs no allocation for an unchanged same-capacity frame after warm-up.
Clean damage schedules no redraw; idle state without cursor blink or an active transition requests zero animation frames.
Resize derives nonzero rows/columns from pixel bounds and cell metrics and emits each distinct GridSize at most once.
Add focused deterministic tests for damage/cache reuse, run batching and decoration geometry, cursor blink/shape, selection overlay, resize dedupe, frame pooling, and headless render-cache smoke.
Do not launch a GUI app; Jamie has not authorized a GUI launch for this gate.
Do not add libghostty-vt, ghostty-vt-sys, Zig linkage, wgpu, or another terminal renderer.
acceptance: cargo tree -p mr-crabs-app contains the exact GPUI git source and no forbidden renderer/runtime
headless render-cache smoke proves stable allocation capacities after warm-up
focused idle test proves clean non-blinking frames request no redraw or animation
candidate_rules: Implement only in the isolated candidate worktree and commit exactly once.
Do not inspect or copy sibling candidate worktrees.
Do not run project-wide formatting, builds, tests, clippy, or benchmarks; the lead owns validation.
Do not weaken S0-S3 tests, compact storage, differential corpus, or PTY contracts.
